requirements.title: This game needs a computer with WebGPU
requirements.body.no-webgpu: Boon Sop: The Unbroken Debt runs in browsers with WebGPU. Please update your browser, or try one listed below.
requirements.body.software-renderer: Your browser is drawing without the graphics card (software rendering). Turn on hardware acceleration in the browser settings, update your graphics driver, then reload.
requirements.body.mobile: Boon Sop: The Unbroken Debt is made for laptops and desktop computers with a keyboard and mouse or trackpad. Phones and tablets aren't supported yet.
requirements.minimum.value: Laptop or desktop with integrated graphics (Intel Iris Xe, AMD Radeon 680M, Apple M1, Snapdragon X) · 8 GB RAM · Low quality
requirements.recommended.value: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 / Apple M1 Pro or better · 16 GB RAM · Medium quality at 1080p
requirements.browser.value: Current Chrome or Edge · Safari on macOS 26+ · Firefox on Windows or Apple Silicon
render.stall.title: The picture has stopped updating
render.stall.body: The game is still trying to draw it. If this message doesn't go away, reload the page.
start.detail: Sound reveals what the darkness hides. Wear headphones to hear where it comes from.
hint.move: W A S D to walk
hint.satchel: Tab to open or close the satchel
hint.sketchbook: Q to open or close the sketchbook
hint.drawer: E to pull open the desk drawer
hint.takeMatches: E to take the red-and-cream matchbox · W A S D to step back
hint.packSatchel: I still need my satchel. It's on the shelf beside the candle.
hint.packSketchbook: I still need my sketchbook from the writing desk.
hint.packMatches: I still need the small matchbox inside the desk drawer.
hint.packLamp: I still need the hurricane lamp hanging by the door.
hint.phoneQuiet: The line is quiet. I should wait a moment.
satchel.title: Satchel
hint.savePoint: E to record progress at this safe place
hint.saveShrine: E to pay respects at the spirit house and save progress
note.checkpointSaved: Checkpoint saved. You can return here if you are caught.
hint.lamp: F to light the lamp (it costs a match)
hint.refill: Left mouse to pour oil into the lamp
hint.raise: Hold right mouse to raise the lamp and read its gauge
hint.incense: E at a burner to put in fresh incense
note.lampDry: The lamp is dry. I need oil.
note.needIncense: Fresh incense is kept at the house altar.
note.incense: A bundle of incense, four sticks.
hint.tray: E to place or change an offering · Esc or walk to step back
note.drawing: Her drawing of the tray. Her lines are like mine.
note.needTray: The offering goes on her tray.
note.trayEmpty: I have nothing for the tray yet.
note.yayResting: Mak Yey’s room is empty. Vuthy took her to our relatives’ house.
note.letHerRest: She is resting at our relatives’ house. I’m alone here.
note.leavesBlack: The leaves on the tray have gone black.
note.yayWaiting: The note says to answer the telephone in the upstairs hall.
note.threadWhole: The white thread is whole. It must stay that way.
note.shedKey: A small key, for the storage shed.
note.shedLocked: Locked. Yay keeps small keys in her sewing box.
note.kanhaPhoto: Mother. Her hands are stained with ink.
note.saveFailed: The checkpoint could not be saved. Keep this tab open to continue.
hint.sokPlank: E to loosen the split board
hint.sokJournal: E to read Sok’s hidden journal
note.journalRevealed: Papers, tied behind the board. Someone meant them to be found.
note.gramophoneQuiet: The record is still. A split board beside the desk catches the light.
note.gramophoneAwake: The gramophone is turning. No one wound it.
hint.gramophoneSpeed: ← / → adjust the governor · Listen for a clear voice · Esc to step back
hint.gramophoneClear: Almost clear. Hold the speed and listen.
note.deskKeyClue: ‘Where the ancestors keep watch.’ The base of the hall altar.
hint.wardrobeEnter: E to hide in the wardrobe
hint.wardrobeLamp: F to put out the lamp · Stay quiet · E or Esc to leave
hint.wardrobeExit: Stay quiet · E or Esc to leave the wardrobe
hint.walkerHide: Dragging footsteps. F to put out the lamp. E at a wardrobe to hide.
note.walkerApproach: Something is climbing the front stairs.
note.walkerPassed: The footsteps have gone down the rear stairs. The hall is quiet.
note.cp3Restart: Back in Sok’s room. Keep quiet. A wardrobe can hide me.
hint.altarKeyPanel: E to open the inset panel at the altar base
hint.deskKey: E to take Sok’s desk key
hint.deskOpen: The drawer is open. Look inside for Sok’s papers.
hint.deskLocked: E to unlock Sok’s desk drawer
hint.journalB: E to read Sok’s final instructions
note.altarKeyQuiet: An inset panel in the altar base. Something small rattles inside.
note.altarKeyFound: A brass key, tucked behind the panel.
note.deskKeyTaken: Sok’s desk key. Back to his room.
note.deskNeedsKey: Locked. Sok said: ‘where the ancestors keep watch.’
note.deskOpened: The lock gives. Papers in the drawer.
note.journalBRead: Three pieces, hidden in the water jars below the house. First, the tent. The incense.
note.portraitAsh: All four sticks. Ash. That sound came from the portrait.
note.portraitQuiet: Uncle Sok. The photograph is old; the mourning garland is fresh.
note.threadBroken: The protective thread is broken on the north side.
note.threadSnapped: The thread is broken. Find the three key pieces in the jars beneath the house.
hint.jarTake: E · Search inside the open jar.
hint.jarOpen: E · Lift the wooden lid. The scrape will carry.
hint.underHouse: Crouch to move quietly. F puts the lamp out. The jars make noise—listen before opening one.
note.fragmentsReady: All three pieces. Retreat from beneath the house, then open the satchel with Tab to fit them.
note.fragmentFound: A broken brass key piece. Keep searching the other jars.
note.jarLore: Folded pages. Read them once you are somewhere safe.
note.jarOil: A sealed bottle of lamp oil.
note.keyAssembled: The key is whole. Return to the chest behind Sok’s floorboards.
note.cp5Restart: CP5 · Back at the edge of the house. The jars and collected pieces are as you left them.
hint.chestRecess: The boards are loose. Look into the recess.
hint.chestLock: E · Try the assembled brass key.
hint.chestContents: Crouch with C, then look inside. E takes each object.
hint.foldedSlip: E · Take the sealed slip. Leave it folded.
note.chestRevealed: An iron chest between the joists. The three-piece key should fit.
note.chestNeedsKey: The chest is locked. Fit all three brass pieces together in the satchel first.
note.tokenTaken: The Bronze Token. The first seal.
note.mapTaken: Sok’s map. Five faint marks along the river.
note.slipTaken: A sealed slip. Keep it folded until this is over.
note.ritualPrepared: Before three. Bring the token to the main burner before the coffin. Keep the blessed matches ready.
hint.coffinLook: Look inside. Sok is still holding the lotus.
hint.coffinClose: Look at the brass handle on the near rim. Hold E to close the coffin.
note.coffinClosed: The lid is shut. The wood is still.
hint.ritualPlace: E · Place the bronze token in the main burner.
hint.ritualLight: E · Strike a blessed match. Face the burner and do not turn around.
hint.ritualSpare: E · Take the spare blessed match from the altar.
hint.ritualHold: Keep facing the burner. I give it back. Whatever he took, I give it back.
note.ritualSpareTaken: One blessed match. Return to the main burner.
note.ritualNoMatches: No blessed matches remain. There is a spare at the house altar, beside the incense.
note.ritualFailed: The flame dies. The token remains. Face the burner and try another blessed match.
note.arrivalEmpty: They’ve already left. There’s a note on the table beside the tent.
note.arrivalPhone: Answer the telephone in the upstairs hall.
note.arrivalMatches: Three blessed matches wait beside the upstairs altar. Follow Mother’s drawing to arrange the offering.
note.arrivalCallEnded: The call has ended. Vuthy will return at dawn.
